title: Robert Kraft: We've offered to make Christian Gonzalez the top-paid cornerback

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Robert Kraft: We've offered to make Christian Gonzalez the top-paid cornerback
sources.description: Cornerback Christian Gonzalez is at Patriots training camp as he continues to talk to the team about a contract extension and Saturday brought some idea of what those conversations have looked like this offseason.
